_ai.what: Prism terminal catalog: animated and static terminal facets (scenes, widgets, spinners, progress, charts, text, TUI, diagrams, ops) rendered with the zero-dependency prism-term engine.
_ai.howToUse: Pick a facet by gallery/category/tags. Run it with `usage.cli` (or `usage.npx` without installing), or import `prism-term` and call play(findFacet(id)). To read or rebuild a facet, take its code from `sources[facet.module]`; the modules in its `imports` are relative to `module`, and the "_" gallery helpers among them are in `sources` too (same "prism-term/src/facets/…" keys). The browser engine is in `sources` too, under the same repo-path keys: prism-term/src/web/index.js (TermCanvas, mountFacet, FacetPlayer, parseAnsi), prism-term/src/palettes.js and every engine module they or any facet import statically (color.js, canvas.js, buffer.js, widgets/*, text/* …), so the island alone can render any facet in a browser; Node-only terminal I/O (screen.js, loop.js, loaded with dynamic import() under Node only) is not included — use the package for the CLI. Facets are deterministic for a seed and accept `params` via --set key=value.

fields.module: repo path of the facet's ES module; also the key into top-level `sources` for its code
fields.imports: import specifiers in the module, relative to `module`: "_" gallery helpers and browser engine modules, both with their code in `sources`
fields.preview: plain-text frame (no color) at up to 60×16

_ai.sources: top-level `sources`: { "<repo path>": "<full ES module source>" } for every facet module (`facet.module`) and every "_" gallery helper they import (listed in `imports`, including helpers other helpers re-export, across galleries), plus the browser engine closure: every prism-term/src/*.js module reachable through static imports from prism-term/src/web/index.js, prism-term/src/palettes.js and the facet modules (Node-only screen.js / loop.js excluded); all sorted by path. Several facets can share one module.
